newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wheelock offers more Parc Royale flats.
newsitem.headline: Wheelock offers more Parc Royale flats.

text.p: Wheelock and Co Ltd property unit Wheelock Properties Ltd said its offer of 30 luxury units at its Parc Royale development in Shatin had been 10 times subscribed and it was putting an additional 30 flats on offer.

Wheelock said its initial offer of 30 Parc Royal units of sizes ranging from 996 to 1,603 square feet at about HK$5,600 per square foot had already been 10 times subscribed during the first two days of registration on Saturday and Sunday.
The company said it is putting an additional 30 units on offer at a price about four percent higher at HK$5,900 per square foot in the wake of the strong response.
Registration of potential buyers will close on Wednesday and the units will go on sale this Saturday.
The company said it would limit the ratio of corporate purchasers to 15 percent, leaving 85 percent of the units to be sold to individual purchasers in a move to curb speculation on property market.
Priority of selecting units will be decided through computer balloting, it said.
Parc Royale is a luxury residential development in Shatin in Hong Kong's New Territories comprising a total 640 units of which 80 percent of the flats had been sold.

The territory's luxury property market has surged in recent months suspected to be due mainly to growing speculative activities. Many property developers had voluntarily introduced measures to tackle the speculation.
